title: Life of a ballot ASMR edition
description:
Have you voted yet? 🤔

If you have, it’s likely your ballot has gone through this same process. If you haven’t, there’s still time. 

The Primary Election is tomorrow and there are over 200 voting centers open from 7 a.m. to 8 p.m. across San Diego County.  Learn more at sdvote.com. 

#asmr #primaryelection #sandiegocounty
